scope: Exploratory controls on previously observed development data; not preregistered confirmation

methods.ridge: Existing 10 current-state features, reproduced as a paired control
methods.node_ridge: Base10 + role-conditioned live health/equipment sums divided by five (10) + live health/equipment standard deviations (2)
methods.pair_ridge: Base10 + sorted ten live pair distances (zero padded) + ten validity flags

selection: Training-only normalization; original seven penalties selected only on each source validation fold; all four methods reported
limits: Human annotation work paused by user; no human or silver labels used.
Same raw node and edge inputs but lossy summaries; not a complete-information set or graph comparison.
No semantic roles, navigation distances or new map transforms introduced.
Previously viewed 9-series development cohort; no untouched test or publication efficacy claim.
Equal-series bootstrap is descriptive with shared teams and overlapping training folds.
No graph retraining, GPU, new downloads, T-side or real-backend work.
